method.asking: advertised starting price divided by the smallest unit size, both as printed by the developer or a portal in our record (AED); per area the median with a bootstrap 95% interval (2,000 resamples, seed 35) and quartiles
method.gap: gap = median asking per m2 / median registered per m2 - 1; the interval applies the asking interval to the registered median
method.limits: The starting price and the smallest size may not belong to the same unit; registered sales include every project in the area and every unit type; a positive gap is not proof of overpricing and a negative one is not a bargain.
method.matching: a project counts for an area when the area in its record is the DLD area name, after removing ", Dubai" and brackets and fixing four spellings (Dubailand, DLRC, Al Jaddaf, Dubai Hills Estate); projects in other areas are left out
method.registered: median and quartiles of the price per m2 of registered off-plan residential sales in the same DLD area (Dubai Land Department open data); we hold only the summary, not single sales

registered.filter: Sales group, residential use, off-plan, value at least AED 50,000
registered.source: Dubai Land Department (DLD), Open Data: Real Estate Data, transactions
registered.what: median registered price per m2 of off-plan residential sales, by DLD area (areas with 100 or more sales)
